hoaxes.title: Anthropic will let IPO buyers pay for shares in Claude usage credits
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Anthropic is expected to price 825 million shares at $70 to $78 and start trading on Nasdaq as ANT on November 19.

hoaxes.title: Hunger Games prequel tickets come with a free mockingjay pin you assemble yourself
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Sunrise on the Reaping opens November 20, with trackers projecting a US opening above $100 million.

hoaxes.title: GTA VI launch copies ship with a free 256GB SSD to make room for the game
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GTA VI costs $79.99 and needs about 212GB on PS5; physical copies hold a download code, not a disc.

hoaxes.title: Apple will let iPhone users swap unused Siri AI requests with friends over AirDrop
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple is testing daily limits for complex Siri AI requests, with higher limits tied to iCloud+ plans.
